entry: Esc opens settings and pauses the current single-player game
displaySafety: 15-second unscaled confirmation; timeout or Escape rolls back; only confirmation persists
integration: Use MarketControls.Held/Pressed/Label for new gameplay actions and HUD hints. Do not hard-code E/F/R/WASD.

MarketSettings.IsOpen/InputBlocked gates gameplay. Current pause uses Time.timeScale and AudioListener.pause for single-player. Future multiplayer menu must pause local input only, not server simulation.
Settings instantiate a runtime URP clone. Source PC_RPAsset is not rewritten.
MarketPlayer.SuspendInspection exits item zoom before applying a new FOV.
RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod installs menu; scene regeneration retains it without adding serialized components.
HUD remains disabled; calculator remains inactive.
B1 existing restrooms retained; 1F/2F new restroom suites and open mall work remain in scene.
MarketSettingsView is enabled only while menu is open, eliminating IMGUI setup dispatch during normal play.
Settings activate only in scenes with MarketPlayer; no global menu in unrelated team scenes.
originalAssets: Original code and existing Unity GUI skin; no downloaded artwork or external assets introduced
